description: List every multi-country coverage area Siima sells — regional areas such as "Europe+", "South East Asia" or "CENAM", and worldwide plans — with the countries every plan in it covers, how many plans it has, and its cheapest total price. Use this for a trip crossing several countries: pick a coverage area whose `countries` list contains the whole itinerary, then pass its name as `coverage` to search_esim_plans. `countries_on_some_plans` lists countries only some of the area's plans include — if the itinerary needs one, confirm the chosen plan covers it with get_esim_plan before buying. For a single-country trip use list_destinations instead.

country.description: Only return coverage areas that include this ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country, e.g. "IT"

currency.description: Currency for prices: "usd", "eur", or "gbp". Defaults to "usd".

name: list_regions
title: List regional & worldwide coverage areas
